mapper.sql: c.id, c.consumer_code, c.name, c.user_username, u.real_name AS user_real_name, c.secret_key, c.return_usage_detail, c.status
mapper.select:
select from kb_routing_consumers c left join ks_users u on c.user_username = u.username and u.is_deleted = 0
and ( c.consumer_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by c.id desc
select from kb_routing_consumers c left join ks_users u on c.user_username = u.username and u.is_deleted = 0 where c.id = #{id}
select from kb_routing_consumers c left join ks_users u on c.user_username = u.username and u.is_deleted = 0 where c.secret_key = #{secretKey}
select from kb_routing_consumers c left join ks_users u on c.user_username = u.username and u.is_deleted = 0 where c.consumer_code = #{consumerCode}

select (select count(1) from kb_routing_rules r where r.consumer_code = #{consumerCode}) + (select count(1) from kb_resource_traffic_policies tp where tp.resource_type = 'ROUTING_CONSUMER' and tp.resource_code = #{consumerCode}) + (select count(1) from kb_resource_quota_bindings qb where qb.resource_type = 'ROUTING_CONSUMER' and qb.resource_code = #{consumerCode})
mapper.insert: insert into kb_routing_consumers(consumer_code, name, user_username, secret_key, return_usage_detail, status) values(#{consumerCode}, #{name}, #{userUsername}, #{secretKey}, #{returnUsageDetail}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_routing_consumers set consumer_code = #{consumerCode}, name = #{name}, user_username = #{userUsername}, return_usage_detail = #{returnUsageDetail}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
